title: Fictional offline exhibit-caption register
provenance: Authored technical-documentation evidence for an imaginary exhibit. No museum collection, publishing system or production metrics are represented.
scope: One offline working snapshot of 12 captions; no execution or publication is authorized.
status_meaning: The categories are mutually exclusive and cover all 12 captions. Corrected and Already clear have completed human review; Pending review has not.
rule: A complete approved package requires all 12 captions to finish human review.
qualification: The register supplies no timing, defect-rate comparison or evidence that the loop improves caption quality.
